properties.description: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).
Manual level requests obey neutral conflict resolution.
Arrival stops the motor in the observed scan.
Prevents degenerate implementations that leave MotorForward FALSE in MOVE_* or mirror SensorC in DONE.

Every constrained ACTUAL output satisfies the exact pinned input-driven reference transition and comparison policy. Finite observations can falsify this predicate; no completed unbounded proof is claimed.

atomic_propositions.arrive: pre-phase MOVE_AB AND SensorB OR pre-phase MOVE_BC AND SensorC
atomic_propositions.finish: pre-phase WAIT_C AND SensorC AND ButtonC
atomic_propositions.CompleteBehavior:
令(Sref[k+1], E[k])=T_PUB011(Sref[k], deepCopy(I[k]), dt_ms[k])。T由normalized_specification.transition列出的固定Python源码和初始状态精确定义。CompleteBehavior[k] 当且仅当所有constrained_observed_fields均存在于实际O[k]，且分别满足comparison关系。Sref只由采样输入推进，绝不由O或候选内部变量推进。
参考阶段WAIT_A/MOVE_AB/WAIT_B/MOVE_BC/WAIT_C/DONE初始WAIT_A；按SensorA&ButtonA、SensorB、SensorB&ButtonB、SensorC、SensorC&ButtonC、!SensorC分别推进一阶。手动清参考阶段，正反转分别为ForwardButton&!ReverseButton及反向对称式，灯灭；自动仅移动阶段正转、不反转，DONE且SensorC时灯亮。
atomic_propositions.MotorForward: O[k].MotorForward: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.

atomic_propositions.CompletionLight: O[k].CompletionLight: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
